title: Wear OS Watch Collects, but does not update phone BG (SW3 / SWR50 / Huawei Watch 1)
symptom: On a new phone (Galaxy Note 20, Android 10), the Sony Smart Watch 3 collects glucose readings but does not sync them back to the phone. The phone status shows 'watch received glucose', but BG is not updated. Treatments on the watch do sync. The issue persists after factory resetting the watch and reinstalling xDrip.
cause: The thread does not definitively identify a single root cause. It suggests possible issues with Google Play Services versions, trust agents/Smart Lock, or a missing location permission on the watch. The user old-square-eyes eventually resolved it after a location permission prompt appeared, and daclaw2k found that disabling Smart Lock (Trust agents) fixed it for them.
fix: Multiple workarounds were reported: 1) For daclaw2k, turning OFF Smart Lock in Settings > Security > Trust agents on the phone fixed the issue. 2) For old-square-eyes, the issue resolved after a location permission prompt appeared on the watch and was accepted, possibly after reinstalling xDrip prefs. 3) Another user found that flashing an older Google Play Services version helped temporarily.
evidence_quote: On my Google Pixel 3XL in the Settings under Security -> Trust agents -> Turning OFF Smart Lock seems to have fixed the problems between watch and phone for me.
